rca_of_issue: Initial Playwright run after the P0 fix STILL surfaced 'ReferenceError: KeyboardAvoidingView is not defined' at friends/index.tsx:1545 when opening the player profile modal — despite the import being correctly present at lines 1-20. Root cause: Metro's hot-reload had picked up the file change but the in-memory module bundle still held the pre-fix scope for the react-native named imports (Metro is running with CI=true / reloads disabled per /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log line 'Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled'). Reproduction: open /friends, click any player card BEFORE `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` → ReferenceError dev red-box at line 1545. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` to force a fresh Metro bundle. After restart, retried the exact same flow (login → /friends → click TEST_charts_user → expand Mini-Apps accordion) and zero ReferenceError / KeyboardAvoidingView errors. The actual code fix is correct; the recurrence was a dev-server caching artifact only — would never affect a production build or a fresh page load. Recommend the main agent always pair frontend import-fix changes with `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` to avoid this in future iterations.
